paite: Ahasueras dam lai in hichi ahong hi a, hiai Ahasueras bel India a kipan Ethiopia tan a, bial zakhat sawmnih-le-sagih tung a vaihawm ahi.
heading: Kumpipa Ahasueras In Kumpinu Vasti Azahlaksak
english: Now in the days of Ahasuerus (this is Ahasuerus who reigned from India even to Ethiopia, over one hundred twenty-seven provinces),

paite: Huai lai a, Susa Inpi a kumpipa Ahasueras a gam laltutphah tung a atut lai,
english: in those days, when the King Ahasuerus sat on the throne of his kingdom, which was in Susa the palace,

paite: avaihawm kum thum kum in, avaihawmte leh asikhate tengteng a ding in ankuangluina abawl a; Persia leh Media thuneihna, bialte a miliante leh vaihawmte ama ah a-om uhi.
english: in the third year of his reign, he made a feast for all his princes and his servants; the army of Persia and Media, the nobles and princes of the provinces being before him.

paite: Agam thupi hauhsaknate leh avaihawmna sang zahtakhuaina ni tampi, ni za-le-sawmgiat a-ensak hi.
english: He displayed the riches of his glorious kingdom and the honor of his excellent majesty many days, even one hundred eighty days.

paite: Huchi in hiai nite zoh in, kumpipa'n Susa Inpi a om mite tengteng, aneu leh alian a ding in kumpipa Kulhpi huangsung ah, ankuangluina ni sagih abawl hi.
english: When these days were fulfilled, the king made a seven day feast for all the people who were present in Susa the palace, both great and small, in the court of the garden of the king’s palace.

paite: Puan kang khaite, ahing, adum, puanmalngat hoih leh sandup khauzangte a dangka zungbuhte leh suangpak khuamte a henden a-om a, tutna nemte dangka-eng leh dangka a bawl, suangchian suangpak san, ngou, eng leh vom a bawl tung ah a-om uhi.
english: There were hangings of white and blue material, fastened with cords of fine linen and purple to silver rings and marble pillars. The couches were of gold and silver, on a pavement of red, white, yellow, and black marble.

paite: Dangka-eng noute in dawn ding amau apia ua, noute akibang kei vek uh; kumpipa uain tampi, kumpipa khuttawi letna dungzui zel in.
english: They gave them drinks in golden vessels of various kinds, including royal wine in abundance, according to the bounty of the king.

paite: Huchi in dan bang zel in uain dawnna a-om a; kuamah phutluih a-om kei; kumpipa'n a-inn heutu tengteng kiang ah, michih in nuam asak bang zel ua ahih ding un atheisak khin hi.
english: In accordance with the law, the drinking was not compulsory; for so the king had instructed all the officials of his house, that they should do according to every man’s pleasure.

paite: Kumpinu Vasti in leng kumpipa Ahasueras inn a om numeite a ding in ankuangluina abawl sam hi.
english: Also Vashti the queen made a feast for the women in the royal house which belonged to King Ahasuerus.

paite: Ani sagih ni a, kumpipa lungtang uain a kipak a a-om lai in, Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha leh Abagtha, Zethar leh Karkaste, kumpipa Ahasueras omna a nasem michilgehte thu apia hi.
english: On the seventh day, when the heart of the king was merry with wine, he commanded Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, and Abagtha, Zethar, and Carcass, the seven eunuchs who served in the presence of Ahasuerus the king,

paite: Kumpipa ma a kumpi lukhu toh Vasti hon tonpih a, akilawmna mite leh vaihawmte ensak ding in, amah et in ahoih hi.
english: to bring Vashti the queen before the king wearing the royal crown, to show the people and the princes her beauty; for she was beautiful.

paite: Himahleh kumpinu Vasti in michilgehte zang a kumpipa thupiak hoh lou ding in asel a, huaiziak in kumpipa aheh mahmah a, asung ah ahehna akuang hi.
english: But the queen Vashti refused to come at the king’s commandment by the eunuchs. Therefore the king was very angry, and his anger burned in him.

paite: Huchih lai in hunte thei mipilte kiang ah kumpipa'n, huchibang lah kuapeuh dan leh vaihawmna theite lau a kumpipa omdan sek ahi him hi.
english: Then the king said to the wise men, who knew the times (for it was the king’s custom to consult those who knew law and judgment;

paite: Amah zom in Karsena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena leh Memukan, Persia leh Media vaihawmtu sagihte kumpipa mai mute leh gamsung a tu masate ahi uhi.
english: and next to him were Carshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena, and Memucan, the seven princes of Persia and Media, who saw the king’s face, and sat first in the kingdom),

paite: "Michilgehte zang a kumpipa Ahasueras chih ahih louh ziak in, dan dungzui in kumpinu Vasti tung ah bang i hih ding ua?" achi hi.
english: “What shall we do to Queen Vashti according to law, because she has not done the bidding of the King Ahasuerus by the eunuchs?”

paite: Kumpipa leh vaihawmte ma ah Memukan in adawng a, “Kumpinu Vasti kumpipa tung ah kia thil diklou hih ahi kei a, kumpipa Ahasueras bial sung a om vaihawmte tengteng tung leh mite tengteng tung ah leng hih ahi.
english: Memucan answered before the king and the princes, “Vashti the queen has not done wrong to just the king, but also to all the princes, and to all the people who are in all the provinces of the King Ahasuerus.

paite: Kumpipa Ahasueras in ama a hong pai ding in kumpinu Vasti thu apia a, himahleh ahong pai kei, chih akigenthang chiang in, hiai kumpinu thilhih numei tengteng kiang atung ding a, amit uah apasalte uh simmohna suaksak ding ahi.
english: For this deed of the queen will become known to all women, causing them to show contempt for their husbands when it is reported, ‘King Ahasuerus commanded Vashti the queen to be brought in before him, but she didn’t come.’

paite: Tuni a kumpinu thilhih na za Persia leh Media vaihawmte'n kumpipa vaihawmte tengteng kiang ah huchi mah bang in agen ding uh. Huchi in nakpi a kisimmohna leh thangpaihna ahong kipankhe ding hi.
english: Today, the princesses of Persia and Media who have heard of the queen’s deed will tell all the king’s princes. This will cause much contempt and wrath.

paite: Kumpipa deihlam ahihleh, amah a kipan kumpi thupiak pekhia henla, kumpipa Ahasueras ma ah Vasti hong pai nawn het lou ding chih, hihlamdan theih louh ding in, Persia mite leh Media mite dante lak ah gelh in om hen; huan kumpipa'n amah sang a hoihzaw midang khat amah kumpi mun leh mual peleh.
english: “If it pleases the king, let a royal commandment go from him, and let it be written among the laws of the Persians and the Medes, so that it cannot be altered, that Vashti may never again come before King Ahasuerus; and let the king give her royal estate to another who is better than she.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa'n thupiak abawl ding a, gamsung pumpi a akithehzak chiang in, athupi ngal a; zi tengteng in apasalte uh, aliante leh aneute kiang ah zahtakna ape ding uh," chi in.
english: When the king’s decree which he shall make is published throughout all his kingdom (for it is great), all the wives will give their husbands honor, both great and small.”

paite: Huchi in thugen in kumpipa leh lalte akipaksak a; huchi in Memukan thu dungzui in kumpipa'n ahihta hi.
english: This advice pleased the king and the princes, and the king did according to the word of Memucan:

paite: Ama'n lah huai a kigelh dungzui in, kumpipa bial tengteng, bial chiteng leh mi chiteng kiang ah apau uh dungzui in, huchi a michih in ama insung mahmah a dante apuaklut theih a, amite pau dungzui a, athehzak theihna ding in laikhakte akhakta hi.
english: for he sent letters into all the king’s provinces, into every province according to its writing, and to every people in their language, that every man should rule his own house, speaking in the language of his own people.
